properties.title: Five wildfires still burn in Turkey as risk extends into next week
properties.summary: Of 206 fires recorded since Wednesday, 202 had been brought under control by Friday, but some remained active across western and southern coasts, with high temperatures and strong winds forecast to persist across 10 provinces.

properties.title: Houthis vow 'full escalation' as Saudi Arabia launches Red Sea coalition
properties.summary: Houthi leader Abdul-Malik al-Houthi warned Saudi Arabia of an all-out response hours before Riyadh announced a new multinational maritime defence coalition, with 14 countries, including Pakistan, Turkey and Egypt, signing a founding statement to protect Red Sea shipping.
